results.title: Enablers, guardrails and engagement for unlocking ...
results.content: In establishing the enablers, guardrails and engagement mechanisms discussed in this chapter, governments should take a systems approach to AI, seeking to understand and address public problems by viewing them as part of a larger, interconnected system rather than in isolation [(OECD, 2017[1])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/enablers-guardrails-and-engagement-for-unlocking-trustworthy-ai_2f817983.html#Kappa_g2g7f844_90fb51a114). As stated in the OECD *Framework for Digital Talent and Skills in the Public Sector* [(2021[7])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/enablers-guardrails-and-engagement-for-unlocking-trustworthy-ai_2f817983.html#Kappa_4e7c3f58_90fb51a114), “leadership that creates an environment to encourage digital transformation will communicate a clear vision for digital government and actively champion its benefits. See [(OECD, 2021[7])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/enablers-guardrails-and-engagement-for-unlocking-trustworthy-ai_2f817983.html#Kappa_4e7c3f58_90fb51a114) for additional relevant material, including skills and competencies for digital government leadership. See also the OECD [(2019[159])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/enablers-guardrails-and-engagement-for-unlocking-trustworthy-ai_2f817983.html#OEC192_90fb51a114) *Recommendation on Public Service Leadership and Capability* for information on how countries can instil values-driven culture and leadership, and ensure skilled and effective public servants, and responsive and adaptive public employment systems. Such systems act as common digital building blocks that underpin government processes and services and enable digital government transformation at societal scale [(OECD, 2024[62])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/enablers-guardrails-and-engagement-for-unlocking-trustworthy-ai_2f817983.html#Kapp_ff525dc8_90fb51a114).
